verdict.rationale: Exa documents LLM-oriented sizing: query-relevant excerpts with controllable context size (exa-docs-23), '10x token efficient' extracts with a recommended 4000-character budget (exa-docs-2), and a specialized excerpt model (exa-docs-17). It also returns clean, relevant page content inline with search results in one request (exa-docs-22, exa-docs-24, exa-docs-35), and a community user endorses it as better suited than a SERP for feeding LLMs (exa-comm-8). One trial user suggested a 'cruft cleaner' to cut what reaches downstream LLMs (exa-comm-1), which is a feature suggestion rather than a documented failure. missing for 10: explicit documentation of how results are ranked or reranked for RAG relevance, independent hands-on corroboration of excerpt quality and token savings.
